Visual management and standard work at a glance
Kaizen — continuous improvement as a daily habit

topics: Supporting data collection and process observation

White Belt assessment and personal action plan

summary: Lead complex, cross-functional improvement projects with advanced statistics, DOE, and change management.

curriculum.title: Module 1: Six Sigma Strategy and Black Belt Responsibilities
topics: Enterprise quality strategy, deployment planning, and governance

topics: Advanced Voice of Customer: conjoint analysis, Kano modelling

topics: Parametric tests: t-tests, F-tests, ANOVA, and post-hoc comparisons

curriculum.title: Module 7: Advanced Analyze — Regression and FMEA
topics: Regression model diagnostics: leverage, influence, and Cook's distance
